answer: Power here is handed out in small, labelled envelopes. macaroon capability token with caveats issued by a DAO treasury means a token whose caveats narrow what it can do, minted by the treasury and revocable in one call. Each token opens one door for a short time, and the mesa is the caveat list that shrinks what it can do. The forge is the treasury that mints them one at a time and revokes them in one call, and the ledge is the ledger that records every mint - a farm asking for a hundred tokens leaves a hundred entries.
